title: Natural Language Code Retrieval for 1C:Enterprise: An Open Benchmark and Efficient Bi-Encoder
abstract: arXiv:2608.19957v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural language code retrieval is a rapidly evolving task in computer science. However, the 1C:Enterprise ecosystem combines Russian syntax with highly domain-specific terminology, for which open datasets and specialized models have been virtually non-existent. We present a comprehensive pipeline for 1C code retrieval: an open benchmark of 3,413 real-world, PII-scrubbed query-code pairs, a reproducible evaluation harness, and a specialized bi-encoder. To overcome scarce labeled data, we fine-tune on 784,057 synthetic triplets generated by google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it from public code repositories, using Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) and a privacy-aware tokenizer. Because the benchmark subsets differ in size, we report balanced-subset macro, query-weighted micro, and forum-only results. Our model reaches 0.5992 balanced macro nDCG@10, 0.5044 micro, and 0.4617 on forum, versus 0.4932 macro for the baseline architecture and 0.5404

translated_title: 1C:Enterprise的自然语言代码检索：一个开放基准与高效双编码器
translated_abstract: 自然语言代码检索是计算机科学中一个快速发展的任务。然而，1C:Enterprise生态系统结合了俄语语法与高度领域特定的术语，针对这一生态系统的开放数据集和专门模型几乎不存在。我们提出了一个全面的1C代码检索流水线：一个包含3，413个真实世界、经PII清洗的查询-代码对的开放基准，一个可复现的评估框架，以及一个专门的双编码器。为克服标注数据稀缺的问题，我们在由google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it从公共代码仓库生成的784，057个合成三元组上进行微调，使用Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）和隐私感知分词器。由于基准子集大小不同，我们报告了平衡子集宏平均、查询加权微平均和论坛专用结果。我们的模型在平衡宏平均nDCG@10上达到0.5992，微平均为0.5044，论坛上为0.4617，而基线架构的宏平均为0.4932。
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对1C:Enterprise生态系统的开放代码检索基准和专用双编码器，通过合成数据微调和隐私感知技术，在平衡宏平均nDCG@10上达到0.5992，显著优于基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first open benchmark and specialized bi-encoder for 1C:Enterprise code retrieval, achieving 0.5992 balanced macro nDCG@10 via synthetic data fine-tuning and privacy-aware techniques, outperforming the baseline.
